phase6.title: Production Database Governance & Retention
phase6.description: Implement governed data lifecycle that keeps infinite audit story without infinite bytes through content-addressed storage, retention policies, and tamper-evident garbage collection.
acceptance: Content-addressed artifact store with strong hash keys and deduplication
Master ledger thinning with hash references instead of embedded payloads
Machine-readable retention policy loaded alongside existing policy packs
Deterministic garbage collector with dry-run mode and eligibility proof
SQLite housekeeping with WAL management and scheduled VACUUM/ANALYZE
Master ledger segmentation with time-sliced segments and stable index
Semantic search integration with DatabaseCore storage and inference separation
Evidence for housekeeping operations with retention event logging
Comprehensive testing suite with deduplication, expiration, and invariant tests
Gradual rollout path from hash references to automated retention

Phase 6I: Controlled rollout path from dev to production
Vision OCR → normalized text → searchable PDF records OCR knobs, normalized text hashes, and both raw + normalized PDF hashes.
Plain text, searchable PDF, and trace.json live under the artifact template above so replay can verify the same hashes.
Replay command (--replay) reuses the recorded spec, input hash, and pipeline version to prove determinism.
The surface harness spins up the minimal slot/session/request stack and records the deterministic state transitions in report.json.
Every report includes registered systems, concurrency state, and an explicit contract version so QA can diff runs.
AccessumFlow orchestrates Diaplasion → Outlineum, emits the standard CLI envelope, and writes trace.json plus per-step hashes.
Replay commands compare registered hashes and artifacts so operators can prove the same pipeline produces the same outcome.
AccessumFlow writes every run/step/artifact record into accessum.db so observability, retention, and replay decisions live in one ledger.
Retention-cleanup is part of the daemon and can be triggered manually or scheduled; it records removed runs/artifacts in the ledger.
Daemon packaging guidance covers the Application Support paths, launchd plist, log rotation, and how to keep stdout/stderr machine-readable.

sprintBacklog.title: Phase 0 – Repo hygiene guardrails
sprintBacklog.details: Document and enforce ignored Inspiration/INBOX corpora plus vendored node_modules so agent snapshots stay lean.
acceptance: Inspiration/INBOX/** and node_modules directories under Docs/ or Inspiration appear in `.gitignore` (or repo lint) so tooling filters them.
CI fails if stray corpora or node_modules leak back into tracked paths.

sprintBacklog.title: Phase 1 – Outlineum deterministic zine pipeline
sprintBacklog.details: Produce deterministic Zine PDF + provenance from `Sources/OutlineumModule/TestFiles/zine-minimal/` via a release `outlineum-zine` runner.
acceptance: One command runs the Outlineum runner and produces `Artifacts/outlineum/zine/{pipelineVersion}/{inputHash}/` with the PDF + provenance JSON.
Provenance includes pipeline version, input hash, git commit (when available), and normalized metadata to keep the PDF deterministic.

sprintBacklog.title: Phase 2 – Diaplasion happy-path spine
sprintBacklog.details: Ingest → OCR → normalize → export pipeline that emits searchable PDF, plain text, trace, and replay metadata.
acceptance: Trace captures input hash, pipeline version, OCR configuration, and normalized text hash.
Replay command reuses the recorded metadata to regenerate the artifacts and compare the hashes.

sprintBacklog.title: Phase 3 – Harmonia deterministic surface
sprintBacklog.details: Ship the minimal Harmonia systems that the CLI surface uses and ban [[String: Any]] across actor boundaries via typed Sendable rows.
acceptance: Smoke harness registers the slot/session/request systems, ticks the world, and asserts deterministic state.
Database queries return typed row structs so Swift 6 concurrency doesn’t reject the actor boundaries.

sprintBacklog.title: Phase 4 – Accessum operator shell
sprintBacklog.details: Deliver an operator shell that selects canonical inputs, runs pipelines, and reports provenance + errors via the shared CLI envelope.
acceptance: AccessumFlow writes one trace per run, surfaces per-step hashes, and supports `accessum flow --replay` on the same runId.
Cross-module demo: Diaplasion output feeds Outlineum preview and the trace records both sides of the handoff.

sprintBacklog.title: Phase 5 – Production hardening
sprintBacklog.details: Make Accessum a deployable node with persisted run ledger, structured admin surface, retention, and launchd-ready documentation.
acceptance: Runs/steps/artifacts live in `Artifacts/accessum/accessum.db` plus trace exports; replay and retention decisions write back to the ledger.
Admin command returns the same envelope as the CLI, reports stuck runs and retention stats, and honors `--retention-days` policies.
